title: Local surjectivity of the concrete underlying-set Kan comparison
statement: Let X and T be schemes in universe u+1, p:T → X, H a left adjoint to the actual abelian small-etale pushforward along p with specified adjunction hH, and F an abelian sheaf with carriers in Type (u+1) [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Lift the underlying presheaf of F to Type (u+2), and let P be its pointwise left Kan extension along p.Etale.op (the pointwise colimit over pairs of an etale X-object and a map from the test object into its base change). Let q:P → ULift(H(F)) be the unique natural transformation whose composite with the Kan unit is the lifted supplied adjunction unit. Then q is locally surjective on the small-etale topology of T [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]: for every etale object Z and every lifted section t of H(F)(Z), the sieve of arrows on which t lifts through q is covering. This asserts no explicit representatives of elements of P and no small indexed cover.

source.place: Proposition 7.44.3, abelian inverse image compatible with underlying sets; Tag 09XN, local representatives; Sites Tag 00WK, local surjectivity of sheafification; Tag 04HR, affine cover-dense etale site

proof.text: Sheafify P. The sheafification unit is locally surjective by the local sheafification section theorem. Base change preserves finite limits; hence its comma categories are filtered and their underlying set colimits carry the abelian operations of F. Sheafification transports addition, zero, and inverse and their identities. The resulting abelian sheaf is the abelian inverse image with its composite unit. For the coefficient-universe comparison, use the small basis of affine etale finite-presentation maps into affine opens. Every etale object is covered by these and their fibre products have covers in the same basis. The Kan and plus constructions on that basis use small diagrams in Type (u+1); lifting commutes with these finite limits and filtered colimits. Extend by descent on covering families. The abelian compatibility and its adjunction are the mathematical assertion of lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures; its currently recorded Lean specialization has larger carriers, so it cannot be applied directly to F. The small affine basis is used to construct the same adjunction in the present coefficient universe, not to choose arbitrary data from that unproved specialization.

Uniqueness of left adjoints to the fixed pushforward compares this abelian inverse image to the supplied H. The comparison is an isomorphism and respects the supplied unit. On underlying lifted presheaves its composite with the sheafification unit equals q, since both have the same composite with the Kan unit and a Kan extension determines that morphism uniquely. Local surjectivity of the sheafification unit is preserved by the isomorphism. Empty etale objects have the empty covering sieve.
